name: io.github.Choppaaahh/sendgrid-mcp-secure
title: SendGrid Secure
description: Security-first SendGrid MCP server: dry-run default, recipient allowlists, rate caps, audit log.

environmentVariables.name: SENDGRID_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SendGrid API key (use a restricted key with Mail Send scope only)

environmentVariables.name: SENDGRID_MCP_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated recipient addresses/domains allowed to receive mail

environmentVariables.name: SENDGRID_MCP_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the append-only audit log

environmentVariables.name: SENDGRID_MCP_ALLOW_BCC
environmentVariables.description: BCC stays disabled unless explicitly enabled
